mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in monthly housing starts (HOUST) signals robust residential construction activity that correlates with elevated consumer spending and corporate revenue growth, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when HOUST increases by at least 0.5% month-over-month.

mechanism_narrative: When the unemployment rate (UNRATE) exceeds 9.5% for two consecutive months, it indicates a deteriorating labor market that reduces consumer spending power and corporate profit margins, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: In periods where UNRATE > 9.5%, SPX 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of cases, or the average return is not significantly negative (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous increases in the consumer price index (CPIAUCSL) and federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) indicate an active monetary tightening cycle that raises real interest rates and compresses equity valuations, resulting in negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: CPIAUCSL and FEDFUNDS both rise > 0.1% MoM
failure_condition: The Rank IC for the interaction signal (CPIAUCSL and FEDFUNDS both rising) is less than 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window, or the 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of triggered periods.

mechanism_narrative: During a monetary tightening cycle, a sustained increase in the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) compresses equity valuations through higher discount rates, producing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: In monetary tightening cycles, SPX 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of cases, or the average return is not significantly negative (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in monthly employment (PAYEMS) reflects a strengthening labor market that boosts consumer spending and corporate revenue growth, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when PAYEMS increases by at least 0.5% month-over-month.

mechanism_narrative: When monthly housing starts (HOUST) fall below 550,000 units, it signals a contraction in the residential sector that reduces consumer confidence and business investment, resulting in negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: In periods when HOUST < 550, SPX 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of cases, or the average return is not significantly negative (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous increases in housing starts (HOUST) and retail sales (RSAFS) indicate strong consumer demand across multiple sectors, which correlates with elevated corporate earnings and positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: HOUST and RSAFS both rise > 0.1% MoM
failure_condition: The Rank IC for the interaction signal (HOUST and RSAFS both rising) is less than 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window, or the 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of triggered periods.

mechanism_narrative: During a supply shock, a decline in industrial production (INDPRO) reduces manufacturing output and increases input costs, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: In supply shock regimes, SPX 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of cases, or the average return is not significantly negative (t-test p > 0.05).
